```yaml
name: Auto-approve Copilot PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'github-copilot-agent'
    steps:
      - name: Auto-approve PR
        uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
yaml:
name: Auto-approve Copilot PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'github-copilot-agent'
    steps:
      - name: Auto-approve PR
        uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v3
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
